name: Animated Armor
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 6

traits.name: Antimagic Susceptibility.
traits.text: The armor is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by the dispel magic spell, the armor is rendered inanimate for 1 minute.

traits.name: False Appearance.
traits.text: While the armor remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal suit of armor.

actions.name: Multiattack.
actions.text: The armor makes two slam attacks.

actions.name: Slam.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage.
